title: 不斷電系統設計
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討UPS 拓樸、儲能續航、旁路與負載相容性，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore UPS topologies, runtime, bypass and load compatibility, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。負載相容、轉換時間、短路保護及電池曲線需按選定設備驗證；本課不作帶電旁路操作指導。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Validate load compatibility, transfer time, fault protection and battery curves for selected equipment; this course does not guide energized bypass operations.

stages.title: 負載與拓樸
stages.description: 以三個具體技術單元完成負載與拓樸；每單元先建立模型，再以對照和反證驗收。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete loads and topology through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

steps.title: 建立負載清單：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Build a load inventory: build the model
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解建立負載清單，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand build a load inventory through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 以 8 kW、0.8 PF 例建立 W/VA 雙欄，另列啟動峰值。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Build separate W/VA columns for the 8 kW, 0.8 PF example and list startup peaks separately. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 以 8 kW、0.8 PF 例建立 W/VA 雙欄，另列啟動峰值。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Build separate W/VA columns for the 8 kW, 0.8 PF example and list startup peaks separately. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「建立負載清單」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把UPS 拓樸、儲能續航、旁路與負載相容性的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If build a load inventory disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of UPS topologies, runtime, bypass and load compatibility behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「建立負載清單」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for build a load inventory, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.title: 建立負載清單：原理
knowledge.text: 額定 W、VA、浪湧及峰值因數分別限制供電能力。
knowledge.textEn: Watts, VA, inrush and crest factor impose different supply constraints.

knowledge.title: 建立負載清單：證據
knowledge.text: 以 8 kW、0.8 PF 例建立 W/VA 雙欄，另列啟動峰值。
knowledge.textEn: Build separate W/VA columns for the 8 kW, 0.8 PF example and list startup peaks separately.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：負載 8 kW、功率因數 0.8，需 10 kVA；這不代表 10 kVA UPS 一定能提供 10 kW。若可用電池能量 4 kWh、逆變效率 0.90，理想續航 4×0.90/8=0.45 h=27 分鐘。 負載相容、轉換時間、短路保護及電池曲線需按選定設備驗證；本課不作帶電旁路操作指導。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: an 8 kW load at power factor 0.8 requires 10 kVA; a 10 kVA UPS does not necessarily support 10 kW. With 4 kWh usable battery energy and 90% inverter efficiency, ideal runtime is 4×0.90/8=0.45 hours=27 minutes. Validate load compatibility, transfer time, fault protection and battery curves for selected equipment; this course does not guide energized bypass operations.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「不斷電系統設計」的「建立負載清單：建立模型」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出能源來源、導體、負載、回流與保護的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「微電網：守住晚高峰」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與隔離低壓模型的接線圖、電流方向、測點與時間戳的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Build a load inventory: build the model” in “Uninterruptible power-supply design”. Draw the source, conductor, load, return and protection boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Microgrid: Protect the Evening Reserve” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for isolated low-voltage wiring diagram, current direction, measurement points and timestamps, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

steps.observationEn: Compare an 8 ms transfer with hypothetical 5 and 15 ms load hold-up times. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「檢查負載保持時間」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把UPS 拓樸、儲能續航、旁路與負載相容性的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If check load hold-up time disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of UPS topologies, runtime, bypass and load compatibility behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「檢查負載保持時間」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for check load hold-up time, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：負載 8 kW、功率因數 0.8，需 10 kVA；這不代表 10 kVA UPS 一定能提供 10 kW。若可用電池能量 4 kWh、逆變效率 0.90，理想續航 4×0.90/8=0.45 h=27 分鐘。 負載相容、轉換時間、短路保護及電池曲線需按選定設備驗證；本課不作帶電旁路操作指導。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: an 8 kW load at power factor 0.8 requires 10 kVA; a 10 kVA UPS does not necessarily support 10 kW. With 4 kWh usable battery energy and 90% inverter efficiency, ideal runtime is 4×0.90/8=0.45 hours=27 minutes. Validate load compatibility, transfer time, fault protection and battery curves for selected equipment; this course does not guide energized bypass operations.
